stage0042_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
Neo Zeon Soldier
「We've moved fifty percent of the
　nukes stored at this base」

stage0042_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
Neo Zeon Soldier
「The rest is loaded into the
　$$ドライセン$$ squad's containers」

stage0042_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Well done, Captain $$アンジェロ$$.
　As skilled as ever」

stage0042_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「For you to come yourself, Colonel...!」

stage0042_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「That became necessary.
　$c has noticed our movements」

stage0042_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$メラン$$
「The Neo Zeon force appears to have
　already seized nearly half the nukes」

stage0042_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Has the rest of the loading finished too...!」

stage0042_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$アムロ$$
「We can't let Neo Zeon have the nukes...!
　All units, hit the suits hauling containers!」

stage0042_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「The $$シナンジュ$$ is here too...!」

stage0042_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$オットー$$
「Calm down, Mr. $$アルベルト$$.
　That's not $$シャア・アズナブル$$」

stage0042_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「His power may surpass the Red Comet's!
　How can I stay calm!」

stage0042_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$カミーユ$$,
　I'm leaving $$バナージ$$'s cover to you」

stage0042_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（Captain $$クワトロ$$... what are you planning...）

stage0042_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Captain $$アンジェロ$$ and Lieutenant $$レズン$$
　will intercept $c with me」

stage0042_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I'll pull back once I confirm
　the nukes have been hauled out」

stage0042_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$レズン$$
（I don't like this, $$フル・フロンタル$$.
　So he means to claim the nukes as his own glory...）

stage0042_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, attack!
　Break through the enemy line and
　hit the nuke carriers!」

stage0042_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$メラン$$
「We've destroyed the entire enemy transport unit...!」

stage0042_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ブライト$$
「But that means half the nukes reach space...」

stage0042_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$メラン$$
「The transport unit is falling back!」

stage0042_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$ブライト$$
「So the nukes will reach space after all...!」

stage0042_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I'll give you that, $c.
　But we've achieved our minimum objective」

stage0042_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Don't push too far, $$カミーユ$$!」

stage0042_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「If I catch him,
　I might learn Captain $$クワトロ$$'s true intent...」

stage0042_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Careless, $$カミーユ$$.
　As you are now, you're no match for me」

stage0042_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Do you have time to worry about others?」

stage0042_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$宗介$$
「This is bad...!
　He has lost consciousness!」

stage0042_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「A greater prize than the nukes...
　I'll take this suit and its pilot」

stage0042_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$宗介$$
「A Lambda Driver-equipped model...!
　$$ガウルン$$!」

stage0042_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「That's right, Kashim.
　I've been wanting to see you!」

stage0042_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「A mercenary's on the battlefield?
　That's just how it goes」

stage0042_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$クルツ$$
「$$マリーメイア$$'s remnants
　and $$アストラギウス$$ folks too!」

stage0042_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$マオ$$
「What's going on!?
　《$$マーティアル$$》 teamed up with
　Neo Zeon!?」

stage0042_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$キリコ$$
（God of War... $$マーティアル$$...）

stage0042_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「You people...!
　Do you mean to spread this war further!?」

stage0042_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Fall back, $$カミーユ$$!
　You're the ship's escort!」

stage0042_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ブライト$$
「This is an order!
　I won't allow a refusal!」

stage0042_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, hit the remaining Neo Zeon
　forces and the mercenary unit!」

stage0042_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「This is thrilling.
　Talk about having my pick of prey」

stage0042_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Let's have some fun, Kashim!
　Soon, everywhere's gonna be a battlefield!」

stage0042_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$メラン$$
「Captain...!
　A new force is approaching this area!」

stage0042_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$宗介$$
「A Lambda Driver-equipped model...!
　$$ガウルン$$!」

stage0042_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「That's right, Kashim.
　I've been wanting to see you!」

stage0042_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「A mercenary's on the battlefield?
　That's just how it goes」

stage0042_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$クルツ$$
「$$マリーメイア$$'s remnants
　and $$アストラギウス$$ folks too!」

stage0042_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$マオ$$
「What's going on!?
　《$$マーティアル$$》 teamed up with
　Neo Zeon!?」

stage0042_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$キリコ$$
（God of War... $$マーティアル$$...）

stage0042_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, hit the remaining Neo Zeon
　forces and the mercenary unit!」

stage0042_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「This is thrilling.
　Talk about having my pick of prey」

stage0042_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Let's have some fun, Kashim!
　Soon, everywhere's gonna be a battlefield!」

stage0042_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Confirmed: the enemy force has been wiped out」

stage0042_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Neo Zeon's taken the nukes and the Unicorn...」

stage0042_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Captain!
　How will you answer for this!?」

stage0042_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$オットー$$
「I'm already thinking about it!」

stage0042_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「This is as far as it goes...
　As expected of you, $c」

stage0042_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「But we've achieved our minimum goal.
　Now, let's focus on lofting the nukes」

stage0042_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Don't push too far, $$カミーユ$$!」

stage0042_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「If I catch him,
　I might learn Captain $$クワトロ$$'s true intent...」

stage0042_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Careless, $$カミーユ$$.
　As you are now, you're no match for me」

stage0042_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Do you have time to worry about others?」

stage0042_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$宗介$$
「This is bad...!
　He has lost consciousness!」

stage0042_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「A greater prize than the nukes...
　I'll take this suit and its pilot」

stage0042_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Fall back, $$カミーユ$$!
　You're the ship's escort!」

stage0042_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ブライト$$
「This is an order!
　I won't allow a refusal!」

stage0042_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$カトル$$
「Chasing that machine matters less right now
　than stopping even one more unit!」

stage0042_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$トロワ$$
「Neo Zeon's working the nukes into strategy...」

stage0042_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$レズン$$
「Did I slip up!?
　Guess the rumors weren't wrong!」

stage0042_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$レズン$$
「Londo Bell and $c!
　Looks like this'll be a long acquaintance!」

stage0042_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Damn it!
　Disgracing myself before the Colonel...!」

stage0042_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「That's enough, Captain $$アンジェロ$$.
　Leave the rest to me」

stage0042_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「But then, what's the point of the guard...!」

stage0042_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I'll need you in the wars ahead.
　I won't have you overreach here」

stage0042_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「At least let me keep face here」

stage0042_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「...Understood.
　$$アンジェロ・ザウパー$$, falling back」

stage0042_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You, $c...!
　I'll pay this debt back in space!」

stage0042_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「This prototype's about at its limit too.」

stage0042_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$宗介$$
「Answer me, $$ガウルン$$!
　Why are you helping Neo Zeon!?」

stage0042_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Like I said, didn't I?
　It's only natural a mercenary's on the field.」

stage0042_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「See ya, Kashim!
　Let's have plenty more fun soon!」

stage0042_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Never thought $$マーティアル$$'d side with Neo Zeon...」

stage0042_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$マオ$$
「They're the type who believe people
　evolve through battle.
　They're probably thrilled war's begun.」

stage0042_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$宗介$$
（I can't believe that man believes in a god...
　Then why is he acting together
　with $$マーティアル$$...）

stage0042_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$バナージ$$
「This red mobile suit...!
　As I thought, it's on a different level!」

stage0042_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Compared to our last fight,
　your movements have loosened up.」

stage0042_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「A shame.
　Keep growing like this and you'll be a fine pilot.」

stage0042_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I can tell clearly now...!
　You're not Captain $$クワトロ$$!」

stage0042_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Hearing you say that,
　seems you've mistaken me, if only a little,
　for the Commander. I'm honored, $$カミーユ・ビダン$$.」

stage0042_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Why do you know my name...!?」

stage0042_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Naturally.
　I know a great deal about you too.」

stage0042_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$アムロ$$
「A presence just like $$シャア$$'s...!
　Just who are you!?」

stage0042_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Why don't you find that out for yourself, $$アムロ$$.」

stage0042_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「No matter how good you are,
　a mobile suit that pathetic
　can't beat my $$シナンジュ$$!」

stage0042_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$シン$$
「You people...!
　Why start a war like this!?」

stage0042_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「A foolish question from someone of $$プラント$$.
　We rose bearing the will
　of every Spacenoid.」

stage0042_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$シン$$
「Don't just assume that!
　The people I know have been trying
　to avoid war!」

stage0042_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$シン$$
「You people trampled on their hopes,
　and I won't forgive that!」

stage0042_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Your desperate act, awakening
　the citizens' will to fight... Well done.」

stage0042_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「A strange man...
　I feel no heat at all when I fight him...」

stage0042_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Your impression is a fair one.
　But I too have a role that must be fulfilled.」

stage0042_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「This man... just what is he...」

stage0042_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「$$カツ$$ told me about this man...!
　A new masked man, is it!」

stage0042_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$ゼクス・マーキス$$...
　No, Milliardo Peacecraft.
　Weren't you once the same as me?」

stage0042_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「That's exactly why I understand...!
　Just how dangerous a masked man can be!」

stage0042_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Me, who wears a mask, and you,
　who cast one aside... An amusing twist of fate.」

stage0042_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$レズン$$
「Well then... shall we?
　Let me see what you're made of.」

stage0042_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$レズン$$
「If you're called Bell, you should just ring one!」

stage0042_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Pilot of the Split-Horn!
　Surrender quietly!」

stage0042_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$バナージ$$
「That guy... what's he talking about!?」

stage0042_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You ignored my warning, so you'll pay!」

stage0042_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「I owed you all from
　our earlier battles too!」

stage0042_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「This is fun, Kashim!
　The day's come again to fight you like this!」

stage0042_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$宗介$$
「I don't have time
　to play along with your games!」

stage0042_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「So cold, Kashim!
　Playing hero with this bunch doesn't suit you!」

stage0042_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$宗介$$
「Shut up, $$ガウルン$$!
　Don't call me Kashim!!」
